source: The farportal is broken and will not be usable anymore.
target: 远行传送门损坏了，已经无法使用。

source: #VIOLET#The wormhole absorbs energies and stabilizes. You can now use it to travel.
target: #VIOLET#虫洞吸收了能量变得稳定，现在你可以使用它来传送了。

source: how to be a necromancer, part 3
target: 怎样成为死灵法师　第三章

source:
Causes a violent earthquake that deals %0.2f physical damage in a radius of %d each turn for %d turns, and potentially stuns any and all creatures it affects.
		The damage will increase with your Spellpower.
target:
引起一波强烈的地震，每回合造成 %0.2f 物理伤害（%d 码半径范围），持续 %d 回合。有概率震慑此技能所影响到的怪物。
		伤害受法术强度加成。

source:
Be very careful about neglecting your defensive #GOLD#combat stats#WHITE#. A long-lasting #GOLD#cross-tier effect#WHITE# is dangerous!

At the same time, be on the lookout for enemies a very low defensive #GOLD#combat stat#WHITE#, and consider hitting them with something appropriate to inflict a #GOLD#cross-tier effect#WHITE#!
target:
请注意不要忽视你的防御性 #GOLD#战斗属性#WHITE#。一个长时间的 #GOLD#越层效果#WHITE# 是非常危险的！

同时，寻找较低防御性 #GOLD#战斗属性#WHITE# 的敌人，然后使用合适的技能打击他们，以造成 #GOLD#越层效果#WHITE#！

source: #Target# is consumed in a burst of flame. All that remains is a fiery egg.
target: #Target#化成了一道火光，留下了一个火红色的蛋。

source: The target is losing hope, all damage it does is reduced by %d%%.
target: 目标失去希望，造成的伤害减少 %d%%。

source: %s is partially buried in a collapsing pit!
#LIGHT_GREEN#[In a last incredible display of willpower you fight the Distant Sun for a few seconds, letting you project your thoughts to Aeryn.]#WHITE# High Lady! Kill me #{bold}#NOW#{normal}#
target: #LIGHT_GREEN#[在最后关头，你以惊人的意志力抵抗了遥远太阳几秒钟，趁机将念头传给艾琳。]#WHITE# 艾琳女士！#{bold}#现在#{normal}#就杀了我！

source: Excellent. Return in a few days, and I'll have everything prepared. Oh, take this. #LIGHT_GREEN#*He hands you a key*#WHITE# It opens the ruins of Telmur, which the men of Sholtar sealed many years ago. If you happen to find a text in the ruins entitled "Inverted and Reverted Probabilistic Fields," return with it and your odds of surviving our portal attempt will go up drastically.
target: 很好，几天后你回来，我肯定把一切都准备好了。哦，带上这个。#LIGHT_GREEN#*他交给你一把钥匙。*#WHITE#它可以打开泰尔玛废墟，那是多年前肖尔塔人封印的地方。要是你在废墟之中找到一份标题是《反转与复原概率场》的文献，请帮我带回来，这能大大提高你通过传送门时存活的几率。

source: transmogrify all the items in your chest at once (also done automatically when you change level)
target: 立即转化盒子中的所有物品（当你切换地图时也会自动转化）
第二套武器：你准备好的弹药。

source: At level 1,2,5,7,14,24,35 get one more 'life' that allows you to resurrect at the start of the level.
target: 在 1,2,5,7,14,24,35 级时各获得一条额外生命，可在本层起点复活。

source: #LIGHT_GREEN#You have killed Ungolë in Ardhungol and saved the Sun Paladin.
target: #LIGHT_GREEN#你杀死了阿尔德胡格里的温格勒并救了太阳骑士。

source:
Observers find it difficult to tell you and your shadows apart.
		You can target a shadow in radius %d and instantly trade places with it.
		%d random negative physical or magical effects are transferred from you to the chosen shadow in the process.
target:
现在，其他人很难分清你和阴影。
		 你能选择半径 %d 范围内的一个阴影并和它交换位置。
		同时至多 %d 个随机负面物理或魔法效果会被转移至选择的阴影身上。

source: This is how the world ends: swallowed in fire, but not in darkness.
target: 这就是世界终结的方式：并非被黑暗，而是被火焰吞噬。

deep_observation: 首句 "transfer heat from a group of enemies bodies to their equipment" 中的 equipment 被窄译为「武器」（「将所有敌人身上的热量转移到武器上」），与同句后半「令他们无法使用武器和盔甲」自相矛盾，且丢失护甲一侧。机制证据：tome 组件 game/modules/tome/data/talents/psionic/thermal-mastery.lua，commit 624a67329fe2ad440c5b344785a9c73fcf22ae63（blob fb674326de446a06397ac1a51a94c60d93171e46），action 中 132 行 act:setEffect(act.EFF_DISARMED, ...) 作用于武器、135 行 act:setEffect(act.EFF_SUNDER_ARMOUR, dur, {power = armor}) 作用于护甲，两者同时触发，故 equipment 指整体「装备」而非仅武器。
source:
Within radius %d, transfer heat from a group of enemies bodies to their equipment, freezing them to the floor while the excess heat disables their weapons and armor.
		Those afflicted will be dealt %0.1f Cold and %0.1f Fire damage, and be pinned (Frozen Feet) and disarmed for %d turns.
		Targets suffering both types of damage will also have have their Armour and saves reduced by %d.
		The chance to apply the effects and the duration increase with your Mindpower.
surface_observation: 首句将热量转移到 their equipment（装备）译为转移到“武器上”，缩窄了原文范围；原文同句明确涉及 weapons and armor（武器和盔甲）。
target:
在半径 %d 范围内，将所有敌人身上的热量转移到武器上，把敌人冻僵在地面，多余的热量则令他们无法使用武器和盔甲。
		造成 %0.1f 寒冷伤害和 %0.1f 火焰伤害，并对敌人施加定身（冻足）和缴械状态，持续 %d 回合。
		受到两种伤害影响的单位也会降低 %d 护甲和豁免。
		施加状态的几率和持续时间受精神强度加成。

source: Target is reeling from an lightning shock, halving its stun and pinning resistance.
target: 目标被强力的闪电所震撼，震慑与定身免疫减半。

source: Detect nearby thoughts, revealing creature locations in a radius of %d and boosting defense by %d.
target: 探测周围的思维，揭示半径 %d 以内的怪物位置，并增加你的闪避 %d 点。

source: You somehow fail to set the aether beam.
Gwelgoroth are mighty air elementals, a pure incarnation of lightning and thunder.
target: 格维格罗斯是强大的气系元素，它们是电闪雷鸣的化身。

source: In addition, you restore %0.1f Equilibrium per turn while this talent is active.
target: 同时，当这个技能开启时，每回合回复 %0.1f 点失衡值。

source: Saved Melinda from her terrible fate in the Crypt of Kryl-Feijan.
target: 在克里尔·费扬地宫中把梅琳达从可怕的命运中拯救出来。

source:
Your Defense is increased by %d for every adjacent visible foe, up to a maximum of +%d Defense.
		The Defense increase per enemy and maximum Defense bonus will scale with your Cunning.
target:
每个可见的相邻敌人可以使你的闪避增加 %d 点，最大增加 +%d 点闪避。
		受灵巧影响，闪避增益和增益最大值按比例加成。

source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*Before you stands a menacing man clothed in black.*#WHITE#
Ahh, the intruder at last... And what shall we do with you? Why did you kill my men?
target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*在你面前站着一个身穿黑衣的凶恶男人。*#WHITE#
啊，入侵者终于现身了……我们该怎么处置你呢？你为什么杀我的人？

source: If the eyes are still glowing, please bash it around a bit until they fade. I'll not have another one of those coming alive and wreaking havoc in my lab.
target: 如果它的眼睛仍然亮着，请猛击它直到不再发光为止。我不想再要一个会突然活过来并把我的实验室搞得一塌糊涂的头骨了。

source: Wild infusions call upon the powers of nature to protect the flesh and rid oneself of afflictions.
target: 野性纹身召唤自然之力保护血肉，并驱除自身的不良状态。
